bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'LOCAL_BOT_API_CONTAINERS='; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(telegram.?bot.?api|local.?bot.?api)' | tr '\n' ',' || true; echo
printf 'MOUNT_ROOTS='; for p in /mnt/g /mnt/G /mnt/gdrive /media/g /home/gace/Project/Gserver /home/gace/Project/Gserver/storage; do if test -d "$p"; then printf '%s,' "$p"; fi; done; echo
echo 'SCANNING_LARGE_LOCAL_VIDEOS'
found=0
for p in /mnt/g /mnt/G /mnt/gdrive /media/g /home/gace/Project/Gserver/storage; do
  if test -d "$p"; then
    n="$(find "$p" -maxdepth 7 -type f -size +1300M -size -2000M -print -quit 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
    if test "$n" -ge 1; then found=1; fi
  fi
done
echo "LOCAL_SOURCE_LARGE_VIDEO_EXISTS=$found"
if test "$found" -eq 1; then exit 0; else exit 71; fi
